kernel_config.author_packet_selection: TRAIN metadata only: SHA-ordered first three DIMACS sources and first three SATLIB sources, then both sides of the SHA-ordered first source pair in each of the six temporal regime/horizon families; 18 states. No quality or conditional-label filtering.
kernel_config.quality_normalization: Macro-average across the eight TRAIN families of exact feasible reward / total graph weight; this denominator is neither optimum nor a feasible best-method reference.
kernel_config.all_arms_share: Initializer, targets/regions, patch construction, include-first traversal, bounds and all caps. Program priority changes only the local feasible greedy proposal and pivot vertex.
kernel_config.cap_scope: Cooperative end-to-end nominal wall time and charged-operation cap; final incumbent validation is charged and any overshoot reported. An ordinary budget stop retains the feasible incumbent.

joint_selector: Unchanged full demanded-interface acyclicity gate, then max strict fit, max exact family quality, min exact family work, original slot
quality_only_baseline_selector: Among all completed feasible TRAIN assessments (including interface-gate failures): max exact family quality, min exact family work, original slot. No gate failure is relabeled as eligible.
performance_deployment: For each bank use the quality-only winner of repeat block0; the four repetitions do not multiply the performance sample size. Keep every other outcome in the mechanism report.
empty_bank: Keep null; no extra AST, repair, oracle or fallback
authoring_barrier: All15 original/supplemental requests must be frozen before execution
